name: Single elimination — heats of 4, top 2 advance, final of 4
description: Generic club/tour format for any number of riders (min 5). Snake seeding; heats have 4 riders where possible and never fewer than the minimum riders per heat (default 3), so a few heats get one rider more. Rounds are generated until one final of 4 remains. Riders eliminated in the same round share a placing.
